name: Isabgol
kitchenUse: One to two teaspoons of husk stirred into a full glass of water or milk and drunk straight away, usually at bedtime.

typicalUse.adultAmount: 1–2 teaspoons (5–10 g) once or twice a day, each with a full glass of water
typicalUse.note: Start low and increase slowly to avoid bloating.

cautions.note: Do not use with a blocked or narrowed bowel, or difficulty swallowing. Always take with a full glass of water; taken dry it can swell and choke.
Breathing in the powder can cause allergies, including asthma, in people who handle it often.
Can lower blood sugar after meals; check your levels if you take diabetes medicines.

interactions.effect: Slows absorption of many medicines; take them at least two hours apart.

evidence.summary: Good evidence that psyllium relieves chronic constipation and modestly lowers LDL cholesterol.
